verdict.rationale: First-party docs show a documented REST surface: Microsoft Graph exposes a single endpoint at graph.microsoft.com, with a documented user-list API. The SCIM docs also describe user and group provisioning between apps and Entra ID. The pack does not show groups or app-assignment endpoints, pagination, filtering, or the auth model for calling Graph, so only about half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented groups and app-role-assignment endpoints, pagination and $filter query semantics, Graph auth/permission documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
